lessonKeywords.description: An integer is any positive or negative whole number or zero.

keyLearningPoints.keyLearningPoint: Coordinates with any values can be plotted.
Coordinates can be described in all four quadrants.
Shapes can be described using coordinates.

misconceptionsAndCommonMistakes.misconception: That coordinates only exist, and can only be plotted, on the lines of graph paper.
misconceptionsAndCommonMistakes.response: Between any two vertices there are infinitely more points. Ask pupils to consider what numbers are between 1 and 2.

pupilLessonOutcome: I can describe and plot coordinates, including non-integer values, in all four quadrants.

teacherTips.teacherTip: Some verbal play can warm your class up for this topic. "Give me a number between 0 and 5". 1, 2, 3 and 4 will quickly be exhausted. Keep asking. 0.5, 1.5, 1.6 etc. may emerge. The game can go on infinitely.
